book.name: Zân
book.title: Zân Zisasiyet yaŋaŋ Zânaŋ meluwaŋ mge.

content: Zisasiyaŋ an ŋen Betesda tu lemunan weyaŋpeye
Ke manepeme Zuda am ekŋengalen kendo temaŋ ŋen beme Zisasiyaŋ Zelusalem mka teman mege.

Âpme Zelusalem mka temaŋ keyet keŋan tu lemunan temanik ŋen sipsip set tokwakwat manzemtemien keyet solonan matatan. Âpme tu lemunaŋ keyet nembet nembet mka mzalaŋ 5 walapeme matatan. Ma Zuda ekŋengalen zelinaset tu keyet kwitnaŋ Betesda makumtemien.
Âpme mzalaŋ keyet keŋanen am zawatmak ma am zikalin beŋaŋ ma am setnaŋ wesiŋ ma selin belin wesiŋ bembeŋaŋ sambeyaŋ ke wemti tu titok mme ekti towewegat damuŋ matatemien.
Ke tatnepeme kan notnaŋgat tu lemunan keyet palen Kawawaŋgalen enselaŋ kululuŋengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ tot titok mme ekti an kwiyaŋ ŋeŋaŋ penaŋ mapalamti totan egaŋ sakwep sekŋaŋ dolakŋaŋ mambemtan.
Âpme an ŋen setnaŋ betnaŋ wesiŋ yaŋ kan teepmaŋ nup kan 38 pi notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ windeŋaŋ bemti towepme egaŋ olapme beme belak ke kwesiŋ matatan.
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ an ke kan teepmaŋ penaŋ matatan ke ekti kembeŋ penaŋ mti yaŋkwesiye, “Geŋ dolakŋaŋ bembeyet nânik ma yek?”

Zeme an wesiŋ keyaŋ zeye, “Amobotnaŋ, an notn dolakŋaŋ penaŋ kwiyaŋ tu titok mme sakwep nambepeme tu keŋan towebak? Nen towesât ewe wati tiktik takuma an ŋenalak sakwep palam tu lemunan toti ilak alik mambein.”
Zeme Zisasiyaŋ pigok dunduye, “Geŋ sindi ambepelet timti met.”
Zeme keyegak an keyaŋ wawadak Zisasiyet nânâpiŋ belak sinaŋ ambepeleti mkaŋan mesât mege kasup keyegak Sabat tagoŋgo kan tapmambien.
Keyepmti Zuda amobotnaŋ notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ an dolakŋaŋ beye ke selen aikti egat pigok dunduwien, “Alak Sabat tagoŋgo kan sutnan milawadi ambepeleti wati kodik ke set dolakŋaŋ penaŋ yek.”
Zeme egaŋ pigok diindoye, “An weyaŋnep egaŋ pigok dinop, ‘Geŋ wati sindi ambepelet timti met.’”
Zeme nâmti an keyet pigok yaŋkwesiwien, “An wati sindi ambepelet met diŋgop an ke geŋ kwitnaŋ nâmtadik?”
Yaŋkwesime an sekŋaŋ weyayaŋaŋ keyaŋ Zisas daŋan ku nâmâtâge. E eneyet am sambe penaŋ tabien keyepmti Zisasiyaŋ sakwep am tuŋgupmaset enzilimege.

Yaŋ ke maneti Zisasiyaŋ an ke sesewat mka temanen tapme aikti aŋkeŋoo zet pigok dunduye, “Geŋ sekdi ilak dolakŋaŋ bep. Keyet geŋ bekanaŋ ŋen mbanikmagat eksemti mamambanik. Mineti nan nukŋaŋ temaŋ penaŋ ŋen dukdan mobeyet.”
Zeme an piwan Zisas weyaŋ ekmâtâti met Zuda amobotnaŋ pigok diindoye, “An weyaŋnewan kwitnaŋ Zisas.”
Zisasiyaŋ Sabat tagoŋgo kan sutnan penaŋ an ke weyaŋpeye keyepmti Zuda amobotnaŋ ekŋenaŋ Zisasiyet nâme ŋep ku beme kan keyet yaŋbemti Zisas kume gakikiyet zetnaŋ mbien.
Ŋenzinziŋ mme Zisasiyaŋ pigok diindoye, “Bienaŋ am tagoŋgoŋepiŋ indamukulem mammin âpme neŋ sepem kegogak mamiyap.”

Âpme Zuda an ŋeŋaŋ ekŋenaŋ Zisasiyaŋ an ŋen Sabat tagoŋgo kan sutnan weyaŋpeye keyet ma Kawawaŋgat nâgât Bipm penaŋ nit mulup tagoŋgoŋepiŋ mamilup zeye keyepmti ŋeŋin penaŋ zime kume gakikiyet zewien.
Kawawaŋaŋ Zisas mulup sambe mimiyelen winde betnan beye
Âpme Zisasiyaŋ zet pigok diindoye, “Neŋ penaŋ sukwep pigok zema nâit: Neŋ Kawawaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ neŋ keŋnangalak mulup ku mamiap. Neŋ Bienaŋ mulup mme ekti keyegak mamiap.
Âpme Bienaŋ Nemuŋaŋ neŋ ke manigoin keyet mti mulup mamiap kataŋ egaŋ weyaŋ zikat name mamiap. Yaŋ mulup mma maegip ke etaŋ yek. Temaŋ penaŋ ewe zikat name mma in ekti nâmtemtem penaŋ mbep.
Bienaŋ am gakikiengatnan mme mawalip. Keyepmti Nemuŋaŋ neŋ kegogak an ŋen gakikiengatnan mma wasât mbawen ŋep mma wabep.
Âpme Bienaŋ ikŋaŋ am mama titiyet ma walelet keyet zelin ku zemdelaŋ zewe. Mulup ke Bienaŋ nâgât betnnan etaŋ beme delaŋ zeye.

Keyepmti amnaŋ Bipmnaŋgat kwizet buŋamaŋ mamwalip sepem kegogak Nemuŋaŋ nâgât kwizet buŋamm mwabep. An ŋenaŋ nâgât kwizet buŋamm ku mwabe beme egaŋ Bipm zemneme koban an keyet kwizet buŋamaŋ kegogak ku mwabe.

Neŋ penaŋ zema nâit: An ŋenaŋ nâlen zet kapi nâmti An zemneme toban ek nâmkiŋpewe beme an keyaŋ walelet ku aikbe. Egaŋ msalen kapiyegak gakiki ma yom dopmaŋ titi set e pemti mama kanzizit elak tiyeyaŋ mamain.

Neŋ zet penaŋ pigok diindoma nâit: Kan alak tatnuwen kapiyet keyepmti am mama mimi bekanaŋgalen seleset mâti mamaip ekŋenaŋ neŋ Kawawaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ nâlen zet nâmti nâmkiŋpewep beme naman mama kanzizit aikbep.
Bien ek mama keyet ŋotekŋaŋ âpme Nemuŋaŋ neŋ kegogak mamayet ŋotekŋaŋ bembeyet Bienaŋ nâmneŋge.
Neŋ Angat Nemuŋaŋ keyepmti Kawawaŋ Bipmnaŋ amgat zet zemdelaŋ zenze mulup ke mimiyet zemdelaŋ zemneŋge.
In neŋ zet zeyap keyet nâme setnaŋ ku mimiyelenok ku besem. Kan ŋen besâpmnen am zaimen am tawep ekŋenaŋ kwizetn nâmti wapmâpme delaŋ zewe.
Âpme am mama mimiŋin dolakŋaŋ mti mambien ekŋenaŋ mama kanzizit titiyet oloŋen palen wapmâbep. Âpme am mama mimiŋin bekanaŋ ekŋenaŋ yominaŋgat dopmaŋ timti teziŋ ŋandaŋ towesât bembesipeŋ wapmâbep.
Kawawaŋaŋ Nemuŋaŋgat yaŋaŋ mamsokbein

Neŋ nanaŋgat keŋŋnaŋgalak mulup ke ku mamiyap. Bipmnaŋgalen zet keyet katnaŋ am mama mimiŋinaŋgat kataŋ zet muluwen indemti dopmaŋ esemtaŋak mutumindawap. Ke wa nenaŋgalen zet yek An zemneme koban egalen zet gawepumti mbap.
Neŋ nanaŋgat yaŋŋ nenak zema in nâme penaŋ ku mambein.
Nâgât yaŋŋ Bipm Kawawaŋaŋ manzemkawaŋ bemnein keyaŋ penaŋ bein.
In Zân an tu zululut an ekmagen yaŋkwesime egaŋ zet penaŋ ŋotekŋaŋ ilak ke zemkawaŋ bemindame nâmbien kemak.
Wa Zânaŋ nâgât yaŋŋ zemkawaŋ bemindaye ke nâgât kwizet buŋamm temaŋ bembeyet nâmti yek. In nâgât yaŋŋ nâmâtâti neŋmagen keŋ gilik zenze aikti mama kanzizitgalen set ke mâti mebegat diindoye.
Zân an tu zulutindende egaŋ lam temaŋnok bemti in mbusatnaŋ bemindeme sokŋan in kan isikŋaŋ bugan ke ekti belak etaŋ egowien.

Âpme nâgât yaŋŋ bee Bienaŋ ikŋaŋ manzemkawaŋbein. Ek ke wan Zân keboŋ yek. Ek windeŋaŋ sepemaŋ igak penaŋ. Egaŋ neŋ mulupm ke mimiyet zemneme koban. Mulup ke mima mulup keyaŋ neŋ Kawawaŋ ikŋaŋgat Nemuŋaŋ e sosok mamimsokbemnein.

Bienaŋ nâgât yaŋŋ in ilak zemkawaŋ bemindame nâmnembien. In ekmak dopmaŋ ek dopmaŋ ek ku mamip ma egaŋ indik tati zet ikŋaŋ esemteŋ penaŋ diindome ku manâip. Âpme in naman neŋ egaŋ zemneme koti egalen zet manzemkawaŋ beyap mee pi ku manâmkiŋpemneip.

In Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋen zet kapigok tazin ke maiŋti yaŋaŋ maomkakalimti nâip. Zet keyet keŋan mama kanzizit aiksenup zematimaliwaŋ zet keyaŋ nâgât yaŋŋ manzemâtâtindainen mama kanzizit neŋmagen titiyelen.
Âpme in neŋmak tusum mamti mama kanzizit titiyelen e ewe wisalagak mamip.
Âpme wa neŋ amnaŋ sekŋ mmobotgat am tuŋgupman belak motati ku manzeyap.
Neŋgut ingat yaŋaŋin elak nâma delaŋ zein. In keŋinan Kawawaŋ gogot penaŋ ku mampeip.
Neŋ Bienaŋ ikŋaŋgat munduman zemneme toban keyaŋgut in neŋ ku nâmkiŋpemneip. Âpme an ŋenaŋ igak nânâŋak koti neŋ an keboŋ keboŋ zemeŋgut in an ke sakwep manâmkiŋpeip.

Mti ilinak notnaŋaŋ notnaŋgat kwizet buŋamaŋ mwat notnaŋaŋ notnaŋgat kwizet buŋamaŋ mwat mmamti keyet nâme dolakŋaŋ mambein. Keboŋ ke ingat kwizet buŋamin zigok mwabe? Naman in zigoset nâgât nâmkiŋpemnewep?
In nâgât pigok ku nâseip egaŋ Bipmaŋmagen meti nin zemndowe neŋ egok ŋep ku mbap. In Mosesimagen mawetekummaip keyepmti Mosesiyaŋ Bipmagen zemindowe.
Egaŋ zet kuye ke nâgât kuye. Yaŋ in Mosesiyelen zet penaŋ nâmkiŋpewiek ze elak nâgât nâmkiŋpenewiek.
In Mosesiyaŋ zet kuye ke ku nâmkiŋpewien keyepmti naman neŋ zet manzeyap, kapi zigoset nâmkiŋpewiek?”
